title: Audio Microphone
description: Generic VAD-segmented voice mic. Publishes one OggOpus binary event per detected utterance. Suitable for any speech-driven consumer (STT, voice analytics, recording).

audio.title: Detected Utterance
audio.description: Emitted when VAD detects end of an utterance. Payload is one self-contained OggOpus audio segment. Metadata (ts, duration_ms) carried in MQTT 5 user properties.
